changelog: CRITICAL: Fixed HTTP connection timeout during update process
Fixed 'Connection Error' after composer dump-autoload completes
Response now sent to browser BEFORE cache clearing operations
Added fastcgi_finish_request() support for PHP-FPM environments
Cache clearing now happens in background after connection closes
Added error handling for cache operations to prevent update failure
Update success message now displays immediately without waiting
Resolves lost connection issue during Laravel cache clearing
description: Critical fix for HTTP connection timeout during update installation. The update process was losing connection to the browser after composer autoload completed, causing 'Connection Error' messages even when the update succeeded. This version sends the success response immediately and performs cache clearing operations after closing the connection to the browser.
